item.title: Test of a Difference in Mean Recovery Times for Two Treatments
item.stimulus: A physiotherapy clinic randomly assigned patients to treatment 1 (26 patients, mean recovery time 71.4 minutes, standard deviation 9.8) or treatment 2 (28 patients, mean recovery time 68.9 minutes, standard deviation 11.3). Both samples have no strong skewness and no outliers. The clinic tests H₀: μ₁ − μ₂ = 0 versus Hₐ: μ₁ − μ₂ ≠ 0 at significance level α = 0.05. Technology gives df ≈ 51.8 and a p-value of 0.3882.

criteria.text: Calculates the test statistic t = (x̄₁ − x̄₂)/√(s₁²/n₁ + s₂²/n₂) = (71.4 − 68.9)/√(9.8²/26 + 11.3²/28) = 0.87.
criteria.evidence: Response substitutes the sample values into the formula and reports t of about 0.87.
criteria.fix: Subtract the null value from the sample statistic and divide by the standard error computed from the sample standard deviations.

criteria.text: Interprets the p-value 0.3882: assuming the two treatments have the same mean recovery time (μ₁ − μ₂ = 0), the probability of getting a difference in sample means at least 2.5 minutes away from 0 in either direction (equivalently, a test statistic at least about 0.87 away from 0) is about 0.3882.
criteria.evidence: Response says 0.3882 is the probability, computed assuming the two treatments have the same mean recovery time (μ₁ − μ₂ = 0), of getting a difference in sample means at least 2.5 minutes away from 0 in either direction (equivalently, a test statistic at least about 0.87 away from 0) (an equivalent statement in terms of the test statistic is also acceptable).
criteria.fix: Say the p-value is the probability of a result this extreme or more, in the direction of Hₐ, assuming H₀ is true.

parts.prompt: Use the p-value and the significance level α = 0.05 to state a conclusion about the claim, in context.

criteria.text: Compares the p-value 0.3882 with α = 0.05: because the p-value is greater than α, fail to reject H₀.
criteria.evidence: Response compares 0.3882 with 0.05, and says fail to reject H₀.
criteria.fix: Compare the p-value with α: reject H₀ when the p-value is less than or equal to α, otherwise fail to reject.

criteria.text: Concludes in context: there is not convincing evidence that the mean recovery time with treatment 1 differs from the mean recovery time with treatment 2 for the patients in this study.
criteria.evidence: Response states not convincing evidence for Hₐ, in terms of Hₐ and in context.
criteria.fix: State the conclusion in terms of Hₐ in context, using 'convincing evidence' or 'not convincing evidence'.

item.model_answer:
(a) t = (71.4 − 68.9)/√(9.8²/26 + 11.3²/28) = 0.87.

(b) Assuming the two treatments have the same mean recovery time (μ₁ − μ₂ = 0), the probability of getting a difference in sample means at least 2.5 minutes away from 0 in either direction (equivalently, a test statistic at least about 0.87 away from 0) is about 0.3882.

(c) The p-value 0.3882 is greater than α = 0.05, so we fail to reject H₀. There is not convincing evidence that the mean recovery time with treatment 1 differs from the mean recovery time with treatment 2 for the patients in this study.

out.changes_listed: The context changes from tutoring and exam scores to two physiotherapy treatments and recovery times. Sample sizes change from 30 and 34 to 26 and 28; means to 71.4 and 68.9 minutes; and standard deviations to 9.8 and 11.3 minutes. The alternative changes from one-sided to two-sided, with corresponding changes to the p-value interpretation and conclusion. The significance level, random-assignment design, distributional assurances, and rubric structure remain unchanged.
out.numbers_recomputed: The observed difference is 71.4 − 68.9 = 2.5 minutes, matching b1. The standard error is √(9.8²/26 + 11.3²/28) = √8.2542033 ≈ 2.873013 minutes. Thus t = 2.5/2.873013 ≈ 0.870167, matching 0.87 and 0.870 in a1 and b1. Welch degrees of freedom are approximately 51.7706, matching the supplied 51.8. The two-sided p-value is approximately 0.3882, matching the setup, b1, and c1. Since 0.3882 > 0.05, the stated failure to reject H₀ and insufficient-evidence conclusion match.

out.changes_listed: Changed context from a tutoring center comparing mean final exam scores to a physiotherapy clinic comparing mean recovery times.
